projects.title: RuneLink
projects.description: For my final project of the Awesome Inc Web Developer bootcamp, I made a social companion site for the popular online multiplayer game called Runescape. Users can create accounts and  login. They can view the current price of every item in the game and also search for specific items and see the change in price over the last 6 months. Users can go to the group finder section to post and reply to posts to find other players to play with. There is also a game updates section which pulls in all the recent tweets from the runescape developers so users can keep up with current game news. Also, Users in game skill levels at stats are pulled in by an external api and displayed on their profile page.
